Full-Stack Engineer/Developer 
 Stamford
 Industry: Consumer Services 
 

 Exp 2-5 years
 Deg Bachelors
 Relo
 Bonus
 

 Job Description
 

  Our company is seeking an experienced Full-Stack Engineer/Developer to help us put the power of big data and machine learning to work for companies solving the world’s toughest engineering challenges. We are a well-funded startup with an all-star team founded by Jay Walker (founder of Priceline.com), and we’re looking for A-players to join our expanding engineering team. If working with an incredible team to build something truly disruptive that can solve a huge problem for society at large sounds interesting to you, let’s talk. This is a great opportunity to get in on the ground floor of something special. This position reports to the Chief Technology Officer.
 

 What You Will Do
 • Work along side former start-up founders and Y-Combinator graduates in a dynamic environment to deliver a high quality product
 • Participate in the entire feature design process from concept through wireframing
 • Own and build out features across the entire development stack
 • Write tests religiously at every step of the development process – there’s no such thing as manual  
 testing!
 • Help streamline our development and deployment tools and processes
 • Contribute to strategic decisions on product and business strategy to help us steer the ship in the 
 right direction
 • Stay on top of the latest tools and technologies as part of the continuous improvement of our 
 technology stack
 • Wear every hat in the product development lifecycle from business analyst to dev ops
 

 What We Look For
 • 5 - 7 years experience in full-stack web development
 • Experience in an entrepreneurial environment
 • Proficiency in dynamic languages and at least one modern web framework
 • Experience with modern front-end Javascript libraries (jQuery, AngularJS)
 • Experience with REST/JSON APIs
 • Solid layout skills (Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS3, LESS)
 • A love of Git and CI tools
 • BS Degree
 

 How We Like to Work
 • In small, super-productive teams
 • With as little process overhead as possible
 • With self-motivated people with an entrepreneurial mindset
 • With people who express themselves, have a positive attitude and a sense of humor
 

 Benefits
 • An incredible team
 • Open workspaces and a continuous flow high quality espresso
 • Competitive salary + stock options
 • Full medical and dental benefits
 • 401K Plan
 • Paid Time Off
 

 

 SCREENING QUESTIONS
 Does the candidate have both front-end and back-end development experience?
 Does the candidate have experience in a small company or start-up environment?
 Does the candidate need sponsorship?
 Is this candidate currently employed?
 IDEAL CANDIDATE
 Our ideal candidate is an optimistic, entrepreneurial and forward-thinking person who is excited about innovation and helping companies find solutions. We look for people who want to work hard, have fun and are interested in growing with us. Independent, creative, smart and fun are all attributes that describe our team. Joining us at the ground level will allow the right candidate to grow with us in the future.
 IDEAL CANDIDATE SHOULD HAVE WORKED FOR THE FOLLOWING COMPANY(IES): 
 Entrepreneurial/start-up businesses
 Small businesses
 Technology companies
 SaaS businesses
 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

 Direct Staffing Inc
